dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: II
dialogues.text: The warnings from our superiors were warranted indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: II
dialogues.text: The device could even extract information from my memories and create more complex segments from them.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: II
dialogues.text: Of course, it is an interesting phenomenon, but I'm not going through the ordeal of training again.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: II
dialogues.text: Let's stay for three more days, and we'll fall back if things look bad.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: II
dialogues.text: I wonder what others will see here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So is that how it is?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The mechanism we saw and the challenges we triggered using it were all virtual images created by the device based on our memories, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of this, we've gotten through lots of challenges and puzzles, haven't we? That device seems to know us pretty well.

choices.text: Completing challenges makes us stronger, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: These challenges are quite interesting. Paimon's kinda excited about them now, actually!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But where did the Fatui soldier end up going?

choices.text: Well, solving the puzzles might award us a chest.
